per_cycle_record.jsonl.[*].cycle_wall_s: wall time of the cycle (the EV per-cycle record merges the response fields)
per_cycle_record.jsonl.[*].response_capture_s: wall time of the response capture

G2_ipopt_solves.logs: every file of <P56A work dir>/<working_dir_ids.run>/logs (network optim_log_case*.log and ESSO optim_log_esso_node*_cycle*.txt): same file names; per file the number of solve starts, every EXIT line and, per solve, the final-statistics block from "Number of Iterations....:" to the EXIT line inclusive with blank lines and lines starting with ['Total seconds in IPOPT', 'Total CPU secs', 'Total CPU seconds', 'Total wall-clock secs', 'Total wall clock'] removed, compared as text

records_excluded.[*].log_bytes: byte offsets into the log file: the log embeds its own path (output_file option line) and the IPOPT timing lines, so offsets differ with the root name and with timings
records_excluded.[*].log_path: path (the IPOPT log path names the working dir, which carries the campaign id)

excluded.campaign_id: root identity (one campaign id per root)
excluded.campaign_lock_seen_by_child: PID, root identity and timestamp of the campaign lock
excluded.campaign_spec_sha256: root identity (one frozen campaign spec per root)
excluded.convergence_depth_capture.network_ipopt_: hash of a file that embeds paths (log_path) and log byte offsets; the file is compared field by field in G2
excluded.initialisation_identity.other_candidates: the sibling records present in init_identity/ when this one was written: a function of launch order and timing (serial vs concurrent), not of the computation; every listed sibling is another candidate
excluded.operational_workbook.sha256: hash of an xlsx, whose zip parts carry write timestamps
excluded.operational_workbook.size_bytes: size of that xlsx (compressed, timestamped parts)
excluded.peak_rss: process memory measurements (ru_maxrss): not a wall time, PID, path or timestamp -- ADDED to the Planner's list, stated here before the run; reported under P3 instead
excluded.response_terminal.capture_cost: timings and process memory of the response capture
excluded.response_terminal.sha256: hash of a file that embeds capture_cost timings and RSS
excluded.terminal_phase_lock.waited_s: wall time (waiting on siblings: concurrency-dependent by design)
excluded.working_dir_ids: path (the working-dir names carry the campaign id)

gate.G4_solve_counts: each of the 10 records: solve_profile.base_solves == 204, rounds == 4, reconciliation_supported and identity_holds True, observed.permitted_solve == expected_solves, blocked 0; parent SolveProfileGuard(permitted=()) verify(0) and pickle loads 0
gate.equality: bitwise: floats by IEEE-754 bytes (struct <d), exact types, equal key sets, equal list lengths; strings and ints by ==
gate.verdict: GATE PASS iff G0 and G1 and G2 and G3 and G4 hold

measurements.contention: shared candidate: B/A per cycle and sum over cycles 1-3 (primary); every B child against the shared candidate in A, reported
measurements.footprint: ri_lifetime_max_phys_footprint of the evaluation child (the harness's --child Python process; its IPOPT subprocesses are NOT included -- the same scope as child_python_process_ru_maxrss), read by this launcher with proc_pid_rusage(pid, RUSAGE_INFO_V4); FINAL value = the read on the exited, not-yet-reaped child, taken on the kqueue EVFILT_PROC NOTE_EXIT event; identity: pid from the harness launch.json, parent pid == this launcher, command line holds --child and the eval key (W91 ChildFootprintMonitor, copied)
measurements.memory_available_during_B: the preflight measure sampled every 5.0 s from just before the B launch to its return; min / max / first / last
measurements.memory_preflight: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied pages) x page size >= concurrency x 4.0 GiB (the S47 launcher rule with integration ruling 7's per-slot figure); gating before each root
measurements.peak_rss: evaluation_record peak_rss.child_python_process_ru_maxrss (bytes, macOS ru_maxrss); wait4 ru_maxrss of the reaped child; solver_subprocesses_max_ru_maxrss
measurements.per_cycle_wall: production's "- Iteration k: X s" lines of stdout_s39_D.log (2 decimals), per cycle, every child; secondary: the interval between consecutive "drained" events of convergence_depth_append_events.jsonl

not_permitted: any change to production code or the harness
